column2: 我兒，要留心我智慧的話語，側耳聽我聰明的言詞，
column3: My son, give attention to my wisdom, Incline your ear to my understanding;

column2: 為要使你謹守謀略，嘴唇保存知識。
column3: That you may observe discretion And your lips may reserve knowledge.

column2: 因為淫婦的嘴滴下蜂蜜；他的口比油更滑，
column3: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey And smoother than oil is her speech;

column2: 至終卻苦似茵蔯，快如兩刃的刀。
column3: But in the end she is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.

column2: 他的腳下入死地；他腳步踏住陰間，
column3: Her feet go down to death, Her steps take hold of Sheol.

column2: 以致他找不著生命平坦的道。他的路變遷不定，自己還不知道。
column3: She does not ponder the path of life; Her ways are unstable, she does not know [it].

column2: 眾子啊，現在要聽從我；不可離棄我口中的話。
column3: Now then, [my] sons, listen to me And do not depart from the words of my mouth.

column2: 你所行的道要離他遠，不可就近他的房門，
column3: Keep your way far from her And do not go near the door of her house,

column2: 恐怕將你的尊榮給別人，將你的歲月給殘忍的人；
column3: Or you will give your vigor to others And your years to the cruel one;

column2: 恐怕外人滿得你的力量，你勞碌得來的，歸入外人的家；
column3: And strangers will be filled with your strength And your hard-earned goods [will go] to the house of an alien;

column2: 終久，你皮肉和身體消毀，你就悲歎，
column3: And you groan at your final end, When your flesh and your body are consumed;

column2: 說：我怎麼恨惡訓誨，心中藐視責備，
column3: And you say, 'How I have hated instruction! And my heart spurned reproof!

column2: 也不聽從我師傅的話，又不側耳聽那教訓我的人？
column3: 'I have not listened to the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined my ear to my instructors!

column2: 我在聖會裡，幾乎落在諸般惡中。
column3: 'I was almost in utter ruin In the midst of the assembly and congregation.'

column2: 你要喝自己池中的水，飲自己井裡的活水。
column3: Drink water from your own cistern And fresh water from your own well.

column2: 你的泉源豈可漲溢在外？你的河水豈可流在街上？
column3: Should your springs be dispersed abroad, Streams of water in the streets?

column2: 惟獨歸你一人，不可與外人同用。
column3: Let them be yours alone And not for strangers with you.

column2: 要使你的泉源蒙福；要喜悅你幼年所娶的妻。
column3: Let your fountain be blessed, And rejoice in the wife of your youth.

column2: 他如可愛的麀鹿，可喜的母鹿；願他的胸懷使你時時知足，他的愛情使你常常戀慕。
column3: [As] a loving hind and a graceful doe, Let her breasts satisfy you at all times; Be exhilarated always with her love.

column2: 我兒，你為何戀慕淫婦？為何抱外女的胸懷？
column3: For why should you, my son, be exhilarated with an adulteress And embrace the bosom of a foreigner?

column2: 因為，人所行的道都在耶和華眼前；他也修平人一切的路。
column3: For the ways of a man are before the eyes of the LORD, And He watches all his paths.

column2: 惡人必被自己的罪孽捉住；他必被自己的罪惡如繩索纏繞。
column3: His own iniquities will capture the wicked, And he will be held with the cords of his sin.

column2: 他因不受訓誨就必死亡；又因愚昧過甚，必走差了路。
column3: He will die for lack of instruction, And in the greatness of his folly he will go astray.
